# Introduction

Greydwarf shamans are aggressive creatures found in Black Forests. They are mossy tree-like beings that act primarily as healers in patrols while also possessing the ability to cast a ranged poison attack.

### Drops

• Item: Greydwarf eye | 0 Star: 50% | 1 Star: 2 | 2 Star: 4

• Item: Greydwarf Shaman trophy | 0 Star: 10% | 1 Star: 10% | 2 Star: 10%

• Item: Resin | 0 Star: 1 | 1 Star: 2 | 2 Star: 4

• Item: Wood | 0 Star: 1 | 1 Star: 2 | 2 Star: 4

• Item: Bukeperries | 0 Star: 1 | 1 Star: 2 | 2 Star: 4

### Spawning

• Type: Anywhere in Black Forest during the nighttime, despawn at dawn | Limit: 2 | Frequency: Very common | Stars: Yes

• Type: Anywhere in Meadows during the nighttime after defeating The Elder, despawn at dawn | Limit: 1 | Frequency: Common | Stars: No

• Type: 1 spawn point near small ruins in Black Forest | Limit: - | Frequency: One time | Stars: Yes

• Type: Rarely from Greydwarf nests in Black Forest | Limit: 3 | Frequency: 12 seconds | Stars: Yes

• Type: During "The forest is moving..." event before defeating The Elder | Limit: 1 | Frequency: Very common | Stars: No

### Magic attack

[1] Creates a 7-meter 35-degree conical blast that inflicts Poison (30 Poison damage). This ability can be used every 8 seconds within 2–5 meters of a player, making it possible to disable the attack by standing close. This attack cannot be blocked.

### Attack

Swings their hand sideways in a 1.7-meter 90-degree horizontal arc to scratch the player (14 Slash damage). This attack can be used every 2 seconds when within 1.2 meters of a player.

### Heal

Lifts both hands up to create a healing mist that heals allies for a total of 20 health, ticking every 0.5 seconds in a 4.32-meter radius around the shaman. However, the effect only lasts for 3.5 seconds, meaning that 17.5 health is healed instead of the full 20.

## Notes

• Whereas ordinary Greydwarf shamans have brown bark flecked with green, One-star Greydwarf shamans have green bark flecked with teal, and Two-stars have blue bark flecked with teal.
